csv_scope_of_work: Smyth County is seeking proposals from qualified Firms to provide Professional Services on an as needed basis. Smyth County will select one or more firms to provide the services requested using Architectural and Professional Engineering term contracting as outlined in the Code of Virginia 2.2-4303.1. Smyth County shall enter into a one (1) year term contract with the selected Firm(s). The contract may be renewed, at the discretion of Smyth County, for up to four (4) successive one-year terms (for a maximum total of five (5) years) as allowed in the Code
